Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative (alternately) of τόπαζος (a "topaz"; of uncertain origin); a gem, probably the chrysolite:--topaz.
BiblicalUsage: Topaz is one stone in the wall of the New Jerusalem. The ninth foundation is a topaz, set among sardonyx, sardius, chrysolite, beryl, chrysoprasus, jacinth and amethyst, and the city itself is the list.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the stone is worth naming because the wall is worth imagining: twelve foundations, twelve stones, and the topaz holds its place among them.
